## fec-vue3-project-standard v2.9.0

- Translated SKILL.md content from Chinese to English, standardizing terminology for an international audience.
- Added a LICENSE file for clearer project licensing.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

- Reference content split into four focused documentation files for project structure, composables/routing, state/API/quality, and performance patterns.
- Legacy reference and skill card files removed.
- Updated core procedure to clarify composable input conventions, cross-framework typing, and component test scope.
- Constraints expanded to cover getter/callback handling and improved component test assertions.
- Output expectations refined to include composable reactivity, Pinia/Router edge cases, and async component testing guidelines.

Version 2.4.0

- Added LICENSE, README.md, metadata.json, package.json, and detailed structural reference (references/vue3-project-details.md)
- Removed skill-card.md
- Updated skill trigger and description for improved specificity and English usage
- Refined structure: split out detailed architecture, conventions, and procedures into dedicated references file
- Clarified boundaries and constraints for components, composables, Pinia, and error handling
- Output expectations and guidance are now more concise and strictly scoped to architecture, not style/test specifics
